svg.text: Bought box with its lid; drill the body only. West wall is the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: short end that faces along the gutter; heights from the floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: West wall: one 9.5 mm window, centred, 35 mm up; four holes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tapped M2.5 at 10 mm each side and 10 mm above and below the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: window, for the sensor board; two holes tapped M3, 15 mm above

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 15 mm below the window, for the lens hood.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: East wall: one 16.2 mm hole, centred, 20 mm up, for the M16 gland.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Floor: two 6.5 mm holes on the centre line, 30 mm each side of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the middle, for the M6 bolts down to the pod plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lid: four holes tapped M4 at 35 mm each side and 28 mm in front

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and behind the middle, for the hood spacers.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clamp the box in soft jaws; centre punch lightly; deburr inside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the sensor's 9.2 mm can passes the window without touching.
